uncited: It sets itself apart from siblings like [Spherical Harmonical Exponentiation](4345-spherical-harmonical-exponentiation.md) by using standard orthogonal spherical harmonic bases rather than exponentiated variants, and from [Real-Time Image-Based Volume Lighting](2202-real-time-image-based-volume-lighting.md) by focusing on surface normal-dependent irradiance rather than volumetric light transport approximations.
**Inputs:** Incoming radiance/irradiance field over the sphere.
**Outputs:** Spherical harmonic coefficients stored in textures.
*   **SH Texture:** A texture array or multi-channel texture storing the coefficients.
**Basis Selection:** Choose the order of spherical harmonics ($L$).
**Projection:** Project the incoming irradiance signal onto the chosen spherical harmonic basis functions to compute the coefficients.
It extracts the most dominant light and stores it separately as color and direction.
